verdict.rationale: Bento's own marketing and FAQ say it scores every release against production history (offline, in CI, and on live traffic), versions and diffs prompt and model changes, and surfaces drift over prompt versions and regressions across deploys. That covers catching regressions between versions. None of this describes an actual side-by-side comparison view of eval runs, and all of it is vendor claims. Missing for 10: a documented side-by-side eval-run comparison view, eval-run/experiment comparison docs (metrics, per-example diffs), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can compare eval runs side by side to catch regressions between prompt or model versions

citations.quote: Every release scored against your production history — offline, in CI, and on live traffic. Catches regressions before users do.
Every prompt, skill, and model change is versioned, diffable, and reversible. Trace any regression back to the change that caused it.
drift over prompt versions, and regressions across deploys out of the box.
